scientific_integrity: The infinite-dimensional claim follows from a Dirichlet Poincare strict-concavity proof and a first-order monotone-potential inequality. A standalone exact-rational checker certifies only the displayed numerical witness. No external independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact optimizer and sharp area law concern midpoint-symmetric nonnegative curvature splittings 0<=r<=1/2 of Kominers two-arc construction at each fixed angle pi/4<m<pi/2; no assertion is made about negative splittings, optimizing the angle, or the unrestricted maximum-area reduced body. The stability bound concerns an induced Green-potential norm, not Hausdorff distance. Earlier equivalent control formulations remain a possible priority risk.
title: Sharp bang-bang area optimizer for nonnegative blunted-quarter-disk curvature profiles
